from lineitem where l_shipdate <= (cast('1998-12-01' as date) - cast(concat($1, ' day') as interval))

from supplier, lineitem as l1, orders, nation where s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey and o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey and o_orderstatus = 'f' and l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate and exists (select * from lineitem as l2 where l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey and l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey) and not exists (select * from lineitem as l3 where l3.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey and l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey and l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate) and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_name = $1
from customer, orders, lineitem where c_mktsegment = $1 and c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_orderdate < cast($2 as date) and l_shipdate > cast($3 as date)
from (from customer left join orders on c_custkey = o_custkey and o_comment not like $1) as c_orders

from customer, orders, lineitem, nation where c_custkey = o_custkey and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_orderdate >= cast($1 as date) and o_orderdate < (cast($2 as date) + cast('3' as interval month)) and l_returnflag = 'r' and c_nationkey = n_nationkey

from orders, lineitem where o_orderkey = l_orderkey and l_shipmode in ($1, $2) and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate and l_shipdate < l_commitdate and l_receiptdate >= cast($3 as date) and l_receiptdate < (cast($4 as date) + cast('1' as interval year))

from (from customer where pg_catalog.substring(c_phone, 1, 2) in ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) and c_acctbal > (select avg(c_acctbal) from customer where c_acctbal > 0.00 and pg_catalog.substring(c_phone, 1, 2) in ($8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14)) and not exists (select * from orders where o_custkey = c_custkey)) as custsale

from orders where o_orderdate >= cast($1 as date) and o_orderdate < (cast($2 as date) + cast('3' as interval month)) and exists (select * from lineitem where l_orderkey = o_orderkey and l_commitdate < l_receiptdate)
from lineitem, part where p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = $1 and p_container = $2 and l_quantity < (select 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) from lineitem where l_partkey = p_partkey)

from lineitem, part where (p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = $1 and p_container in ('sm case', 'sm box', 'sm pack', 'sm pkg') and l_quantity >= $2 and l_quantity <= ($3 + 10) and p_size between 1 and 5 and l_shipmode in ('air', 'air reg') and l_shipinstruct = 'deliver in person') or (p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = $4 and p_container in ('med bag', 'med box', 'med pkg', 'med pack') and l_quantity >= $5 and l_quantity <= ($6 + 10) and p_size between 1 and 10 and l_shipmode in ('air', 'air reg') and l_shipinstruct = 'deliver in person') or (p_partkey = l_partkey and p_brand = $7 and p_container in ('lg case', 'lg box', 'lg pack', 'lg pkg') and l_quantity >= $8 and l_quantity <= ($9 + 10) and p_size between 1 and 15 and l_shipmode in ('air', 'air reg') and l_shipinstruct = 'deliver in person')

from partsupp, part where p_partkey = ps_partkey and p_brand <> $1 and p_type not like $2 and p_size in ($3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10) and not ps_suppkey in (select s_suppkey from supplier where s_comment like '%customer%complaints%')

from supplier, nation where s_suppkey in (select ps_suppkey from partsupp where ps_partkey in (select p_partkey from part where p_name like $1) and ps_availqty > (select 0.5 * sum(l_quantity) from lineitem where l_partkey = ps_partkey and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey and l_shipdate >= cast($2 as date) and l_shipdate < (cast($3 as date) + cast('1' as interval year)))) and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_name = $4
